name: Chinese Government Scholarship, High Level Postgraduate Program and Silk-Road Program (Type B), 2027. Applications 1 November 2026 to 31 January 2027
languageRequirement: Chinese-taught: HSK 4 with 180 (valid for 2 years). English-taught: TOEFL 80, IELTS 5.5 or Duolingo 100, or previous study taught in English; applicants from English-speaking countries are exempt. Age: Master's under 35, PhD under 40. A supervisor's acceptance letter is required for PhD applicants.

name: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship (formerly Confucius Institute Scholarship): one semester, up to 5 months, March 2027 start
provider: Centre for Language Education and Cooperation (CLEC)
languageRequirement: HSK 3 with 180 and an HSKK score. Usually not open to people who received a similar scholarship in the past three years. Date of birth between 1 September 1991 and 31 August 2010 (in-service Chinese teachers: from 1 September 1981). You apply on CLEC's scholarship website, not on the university's site.
